intro p hp
have h_in : p ∈ {q : ℕ |
      q.Prime ∧ Odd q ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, n.maxPrimeFac * (n + 1).maxPrimeFac ≠ 2 * p} := by
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  refine ⟨hp.1, hp.2, fun n hn0 ↦ ?_⟩
  have hpn : Nat.maxPrimeFac n ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hn0
  have hpn1 : Nat.maxPrimeFac (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hn0
  have hodd : Odd (Nat.maxPrimeFac n * Nat.maxPrimeFac (n + 1)) := by
    apply Odd.mul
    exact Nat.odd_iff_not_even.mp (Nat.maxPrimeFac.odd hp.1 hpn)
    exact Nat.odd_iff_not_even.mp (Nat.maxPrimeFac.odd hp.1 hpn1)
  rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even] at hodd
  rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even] at hp.2
  rw [Nat.even_iff_not_odd]
  intro heven
  exact heven hodd
have hinf : ({p : ℕ |
      p.Prime ∧ Odd p ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, n.maxPrimeFac * (n + 1).maxPrimeFac ≠ 2 * p : Set ℕ}).Infinite := by
  apply Set.Infinite.mono (fun q hq ↦ by
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hq ⊢
    exact ⟨hq.1, hq.2, hq.3⟩)
  exact (Set.Infinite.subset (Set.mem_setOf_mpr (fun q ↦ q.Prime)) Set.infinite_range' (fun k ↦ by rw [Nat.Prime.add_one (by norm_num)]
    exact (Nat.Prime.add_one (by norm_num)).1))
  intro q hq
  have hq2 : q.Prime := hq
  have hq3 : Odd q := by
    rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even]
    intro heq
    cases' hq2.dvd_of_dvd_mul (by norm_num) heq with h2 hq1
    have hq1' : 2 ≠ q := by omega
    exact hq1' (by omega)
  exact ⟨hq2, hq3, fun n hn0 ↦ by
    have hpn : Nat.maxPrimeFac n ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hn0
    have hpn1 : Nat.maxPrimeFac (n + 1) ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hn0
    have hodd : Odd (Nat.maxPrimeFac n * Nat.maxPrimeFac (n + 1)) := by
      apply Odd.mul
      exact Nat.odd_iff_not_even.mp (Nat.maxPrimeFac.odd hq2 hpn)
      exact Nat.odd_iff_not_even.mp (Nat.maxPrimeFac.odd hq2 hpn1)
    rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even] at hodd
    rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even] at hq3
    rw [Nat.even_iff_not_odd]
    intro heven
    exact heven hodd⟩
